candidates.source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (register of licensed financial institutions, PDF series)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated enumeration of every licensed bank, microfinance institution, non-bank financial institution, payment institution, e-money institution, insurer and pension fund in Kosovo. This is the closest thing to a complete buyer universe for banking/payments vendors in XK, and it is periodically re-issued as a dated PDF, so successive versions give entry/exit signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (monthly) fetch of the dated PDF from the BQK licensing/registers page; diff successive editions to detect new licences and revocations. PDF table extraction. Note WordPress uploads path is date-stamped, so the page listing must be crawled, not the URL guessed.
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara pagesa
local_language_terms_used: Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara

candidates.source_name: BQK — Sistemet e pagesave (Payment Systems section, main hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Top-level hub for national payment infrastructure: KIPS interbank system, its operating scheme, payment system oversight, and payment statistics. The pointer that leads to the specific pages naming the switch/RTGS/instant-payment components and their participants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the section tree in sq/sr/en (?lang= switch) with a browser-grade fetcher; site returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetcher, so use a real user-agent / headless browser.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Albanian and Serbian searches
queries_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës raporti i sistemit të pagesave KIPS
Centralna banka Republike Kosovo licencirane finansijske institucije registar platni sistem
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned to a plain markdown-converting fetcher on https://bqk-kos.org/sistemet-e-pagesave/?lang=en — treated as bot-defended-but-live, not dead.

candidates.source_name: BQK — Skema e funksionimit të Sistemit Ndërbankar të Pagesave (KIPS operating scheme)
candidates.why_relevant: Describes the architecture of KIPS and enumerates its direct participants (reported as 14 direct participants: 11 commercial banks, the CBK itself, Treasury/MF, and KPST). Direct read on who is connected to the national rails — i.e. the accounts a payments vendor must integrate with.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot of the page in sq/en/sr; extract participant list and diff.
queries_used: BQK pjesëmarrësit në sistemin KIPS lista e bankave anëtare sistemi ndërbankar i pagesave

candidates.source_name: BQK — Mbikëqyrja e Sistemit të Pagesave (payment system oversight)
candidates.why_relevant: Oversight page setting out CBK's statutory oversight of payment systems and instruments; typically names overseen systems/schemes and the criteria applied. Useful for identifying which schemes and operators are formally recognised in Kosovo.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual page snapshot; follow outbound PDF links.
queries_used: BQK pjesëmarrësit në sistemin KIPS lista e bankave anëtare sistemi ndërbankar i pagesave

candidates.source_name: BQK — Tenderët (CBK tender announcements)
candidates.why_relevant: The CBK is itself a procurer of IT systems, cash-handling and currency-processing equipment, ATM/branch infrastructure and services. Its own tender and contract-award notices name incumbent vendors and contract values — direct competitive intelligence for a payments-technology supplier.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the tenders listing; harvest the linked PDF notices (njoftim për kontratë / njoftim për dhënie të kontratës) and extract awardee, lot, value, procedure type.
queries_used: bqk-kos.org tenderë prokurim njoftim për kontratë BQK

candidates.source_name: BQK — Planifikimi vjetor i prokurimeve në BQK (CBK annual procurement plan)
candidates.why_relevant: Forward-looking: the annual procurement plan signals IT, security, cash-handling and payment-infrastructure purchases before the tender is published. Highest-value early-warning source for a vendor selling to the central bank.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/quarterly check; download the plan document and extract line items with CPV-like descriptions and planned dates.
queries_used: bqk-kos.org tenderë prokurim njoftim për kontratë BQK

candidates.source_name: BQK — Publikimet (publications hub: Annual Report, Financial Stability Report, Macroeconomic Developments, Monthly Financial System Information)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index of CBK periodicals. The Annual Report contains a dedicated payment-system chapter (KIPS volumes/values, card and terminal counts, SEPA and instant-payment project status); the Financial Stability Report profiles the banking sector's structure and digital-channel adoption. Both name infrastructure projects and their partners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the publications index in sq/sr/en; download each new PDF; run keyword extraction over the payment-system chapters (KIPS, TIPS, SEPA, kartela, POS, ATM, e-banking).
queries_used: bqk-kos.org "raporti vjetor" OR "raporti i stabilitetit financiar" publikimet faqe zyrtare

candidates.source_name: BQK — Godišnji Izveštaj / CBK Annual Report PDF series (Serbian and Albanian editions)
candidates.why_relevant: The full-text annual reports, back to at least 2017, are directly downloadable. They carry the payment-system chapter year by year — the single best time series on KIPS transaction volumes/values, card and terminal estate, and named modernisation projects. Serbian editions confirm sr-language coverage of the same content.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Back-fill the historic PDF series (CBK_GI_YYYY / BQK_RV_YYYY naming), then annual pickup. Parse the payment-system chapter tables.

candidates.why_relevant: Machine-friendly time series on the financial and external sector, including payment-system indicators (cards issued, ATM and POS terminal counts, transaction volumes). Quantifies terminal-estate and acceptance-network growth — the direct addressable market for POS/ATM hardware and acquiring software.

candidates.why_relevant: A dedicated CBK report on card usage in Kosovo, with card-scheme, ATM/POS and transaction breakdowns. Directly sizes the card-acceptance market and its growth rate (e.g. domestic POS card payments reported growing ~30.7% in 2023).

candidates.why_relevant: The statute that creates the CBK's publication and oversight duties for payment systems, defines participant categories and licensing obligations. Establishes what must legally exist as a public register — the backbone assumption of this whole coverage cell.

candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative publisher of the CBK Law (Nr. 03/L-209), the Payment System Law, the Crypto-Assets Law and all amendments, in sq/sr/en. negative_findings.description: bqk-kos.org returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain markdown-converting fetcher on https://bqk-kos.org/sistemet-e-pagesave/?lang=en, so no CBK page could be fetched directly in this pass; all candidate URLs come from search-index evidence rather than direct retrieval.

coverage_gaps.description: CBK historical tender awards were only sampled (IT equipment 10 lots, mobile telephony, group life insurance). No systematic multi-year view of CBK IT / cash-handling / ATM / currency-processing awards and their winners was assembled.

coverage_gaps.description: Neither the CBK material found nor the external reporting names the software vendor of KIPS itself (the existing RTGS/ACH), only the incoming Banca d'Italia TIPS-clone instant-payment layer. The incumbent switch/RTGS supplier for Kosovo remains unidentified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Mine older CBK annual reports (2010-2018 editions, available as CBK_GI_YYYY PDFs) and CBK tender archives for the original KIPS implementation and maintenance contracts, which should name the incumbent supplier.

coverage_gaps.description: The whole cell depends on one bot-defended domain (bqk-kos.org) plus one procurement portal with a history of multi-day outages (e-Prokurimi).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design collection with a headless-browser fallback, PDF-direct fetching from wp-content/uploads, and an archive fallback (web.archive.org) for both domains.

brief: The Central Bank of Kosovo is a genuinely rich pointer source for this market: it publishes a periodically re-dated PDF register enumerating every licensed bank, MFI, non-bank financial institution, payment institution and e-money institution in Kosovo, a payment-systems section describing KIPS and its ~14 direct participants, an annual report series (sq and sr, back to at least 2017) carrying the payment-system chapter, and a fast-moving regulations repository that in late 2025 opened non-bank PSP access to payment systems and introduced crypto-asset operator licensing. It is also a public procurer in its own right, with its own tenders page and annual procurement plan, mirrored into the national e-Prokurimi platform — the route to naming incumbent IT and cash-handling suppliers. Two structural constraints shape collection: the domain returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetcher (bot-defended, not dead) and everything of register value is published as PDF rather than as structured data, so version-diffing dated PDFs is the practical enumeration method. The most important open gaps are the absence of a confirmed CBK licensing-decisions archive, no press-release feed pinned down, and no identification of the incumbent KIPS switch/RTGS supplier — while the incoming instant-payment rail is externally confirmed as a Banca d'Italia TIPS clone under a Western Balkans agreement, with Kosovo's SEPA application pending.
